theorems.name: Submission.dgc_tube_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (d k : ℕ), k ≤ d → ∀ (a : Eucl d) (La : Set (Eucl d)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin d), J.card = k ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ n : ℤ, y i - a i = n} → ∀ (σ : ℝ) (x : Eucl d), infDist x La < σ → ∃ J : Finset (Fin d), J.card = k ∧ ∃ z : J → ℤ, ∑ i : J, (x i - a i - z i) ^ 2 < σ ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
